items.title: Mrs. Arnold Metoyer Interview, 1960-10-19
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] ...where Robichaux had a band... I'm sure he played at Robichaux. [INTERVIEWEE] Yeah. He played at Robichaux.

ctx.x: It was two brothers. It was two brothers.
Had you told us that he ever played in any of the theater, like the Lyric Theater where Robichaux had a band, I know for a while. I'm sure he played at Robichaux.

Yeah. He played at Robichaux. Yeah. He played at Robichaux. That's where he played Salem and Tuck Whitney, at the Lyric. At the Lyric. That's the show he played. That's what I wondered if it might have been. Yeah. They used to come in once a year. Into the mornings. Well, you played all of the night club, the hour, whatever the hour on the Amplestreet. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah.
